passes.title: Built-in checks
passes.detail: Every number and figure comes from code that runs in the page or in the MATLAB/Octave labs; every page is rendered on desktop and phone and every internal link is checked before each release.

passes.title: Expert review
passes.detail: The author, a practising ultrasound engineer, and several reviewers from the ultrasound field reviewed modules in their areas for technical accuracy, clarity and practical relevance.

passes.title: Claim-by-claim audit of all 33 modules
passes.detail: Each module's key results were re-derived independently and every quantitative claim and citation was checked: 1,405 claims checked, 212 wrong or imprecise statements fixed and re-verified.

passes.title: Primary-source recheck
passes.detail: The 56 claims the audit could not confirm were rechecked against primary sources: 32 confirmed, 9 corrected, 12 reworded or removed, 3 still open (listed below).

passes.title: Independent external review
passes.detail: An independent external review of the site and repository; 5 issues confirmed and fixed.

passes.title: Reproducible external audit
passes.detail: All 159 MATLAB/Octave labs were run in GNU Octave 8.4 (all completed), 609 numerical checks were run (604 passed; the 5 failures were real defects, now fixed) and 127 DOIs were resolved (one wrong DOI, now fixed); 11 issues fixed in total.

passes.title: Second equation-by-equation pass
passes.detail: 15 higher-risk modules (06–10, 13, 16–18, 20–22, 25, 30, 32) re-checked for domains, units, index ranges and stated assumptions, with every worked number recomputed: 58 small corrections, including one lab-script bug.

passes.title: Standards and robustness review
passes.detail: Module 22 compared with the IEC 62359 and IEC 60601-2-37 requirements as reported by an external review (clearly marked where unconfirmed); Module 25 adaptive beamforming checked against independent reference cases.

passes.title: Imaging modes and capstones: second audit
passes.detail: Modules 28–33, including the new pulsed-wave sections, re-audited equation by equation, about 850 numbers recomputed, every demo driven, every lab run and every reference checked against its source; corrections are listed under version 1.3.

passes.title: Transducer modules expanded and audited
passes.detail: New design-to-production material in Modules 16–18 written against cited sources and audited independently: equations and about 90 numbers recomputed, citations checked, new demos driven.

passes.title: Independent pre-publication audit and full lab run
passes.detail: An independent scientific and software audit raised 29 items (4 stop-ship, 11 to correct, 14 to qualify); all scientific items were reviewed and fixed or qualified, one (Imbault cut-offs) stays open. All 171 MATLAB/Octave labs were run in GNU Octave on the release candidate (all completed), and deployment now runs the build, link, render and Octave checks on the exact commit before publishing.

passes.title: Readability pass on summary boxes, demos and charts
passes.detail: Summary boxes rewritten to be self-contained (owner-reviewed before embedding). Demo controls, readouts, method cards, chart axes and legends revised in all 36 modules; labels flagged by the writers were checked independently against each module's equations and code (11 corrected).

passes.title: Your review
passes.detail: More expert reviewers are welcome, and reviewers are credited here by name if they wish. Use the "Report an error" link on any module page.
